choices.why: This light ash desk with tapered legs is the most purely Nordic option, and at 118 cm it gives a generous workspace beside the window.
Its upholstered seat and back make it the most comfortable choice for long work sessions, and its natural wood frame matches the light desk.
It is tall and white, so it blends into the white right-hand wall in clean Nordic style and leaves room for the reading armchair near the window.
With its headrest, the bentwood Poäng is the most comfortable chair for reading, and its dark frame echoes the black window frames while the soft grey fabric stays light.
The swing arm can place the light right over the armchair for reading, and its white shade suits the bright Nordic room.

answer.why: Light wood on the desk and chair, white on the bookcase and lamp, and soft grey on the armchair keep the corner bright and Nordic, matching the light floor and white walls. The armchair's dark frame ties in with the black frames of the large window.
